content.value: A reheat cycle using steam, works between pressure of 130 bar and 0.05 bar. The steam is supplied at $4 5 0 \%$ on entry to the turbine and after expansion to a dryness fraction of 0.95, it is reheated to $4 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ before completing its expansion to the condenser pressure. Find the reheat pressure and cycle efficiency assuming isentropic expansion in the turbines and feed pump.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
